items.source: A Map<String,Object> to represent any entity as it's returned from Elasticsearch and before it is converted to a Document.
items.translation: 一个 Map，用于表示从 Elasticsearch 返回的任意实体，并在其转换为 Document 之前。

items.source:
This package contains classes that use the new Elasticsearch client library (co.elastic.clients:elasticsearch-java)
to access Elasticsearch.
items.translation: 本包包含使用新的 Elasticsearch 客户端库（co.elastic.clients:elasticsearch-java）来访问 Elasticsearch 的类。

items.source: Uses of EntityAsMap in org.springframework.data.elasticsearch.client.elc
